question: This weekend's Mexico City F1 track is named for brothers Ricardo and Pedro Rodríguez. In 1961, Ricardo qualified second at Monza in his Ferrari debut. How old was he?
question_short: Ricardo Rodríguez put a Ferrari on F1's front row in his 1961 debut. How old?
answer_detail: At 19 years, 208 days, he was F1's youngest front-row starter until Max Verstappen in 2016. He was killed practicing at the Mexico City track on Nov. 1, 1962, at age 20.
answer_short: He was 19, F1's youngest front-row starter until Max Verstappen in 2016.
